1.name: Blink Dagger
1.desc:
Active: Blink
Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

Blink Dagger cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.
1.lore: The fabled dagger used by the fastest assassin ever to walk the lands.

600.name: Overwhelming Blink
600.desc:
Active: Overwhelming Blink
Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a 800 AoE take damage equal to 100 + 50% of your strength and an additional 100% over time, and have 35% movement speed slow and 70 attack speed slow for 4.5 seconds.

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.
600.lore: A horrifying dagger forged in the chaos maw and nigh untouchable by mortal hands.

603.name: Swift Blink
603.desc:
Active: Swift Blink
Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, you gain 40% phased movement speed and +35 Agility for 6 seconds.

Swift Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.
603.lore: A cunning blade able to anticipate and enable its bearer's movements.

604.name: Arcane Blink
604.desc:
Active: Arcane Blink
Teleport to a target point up to 1400 units away.

After teleportation, you restore 250 health and 100 mana.

Arcane Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.
604.lore: A revitalizing tool to help bear the weight of arcane expenditure.

2.name: Blades of Attack
2.lore: The damage of these small, concealable blades should not be underestimated.

3.name: Broadsword
3.lore: The classic weapon of choice for knights, this blade is sturdy and reliable for slaying enemies.

4.name: Chainmail
4.lore: A medium weave of metal chains.

5.name: Claymore
5.lore: A sword that can cut through armor, it's a commonly chosen first weapon for budding swordsmen.

6.name: Helm of Iron Will
6.lore: The helmet of a legendary warrior who fell in battle.

7.name: Javelin
7.desc:
Passive: Pierce
Grants each attack a 25% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 60 bonus magical damage.
7.lore: A rather typical spear that can sometimes pierce through an enemy's armor when used to attack.

8.name: Mithril Hammer
8.lore: A hammer forged of pure mithril.

9.name: Platemail
9.lore: Thick metal plates that protect the entire upper body. Avoid dropping on feet.

10.name: Quarterstaff
10.lore: A basic staff that allows you to strike quickly.

11.name: Quelling Blade
11.desc:
Active: Chop Tree
Destroy a target tree.

Passive: Quell
Increases attack damage against non-hero units by 8 for melee heroes, and 4 for ranged.
notes: Effects of multiple quelling blades do not stack.
11.lore: The axe of a fallen gnome, it allows you to effectively maneuver the forest.

237.name: Faerie Fire
237.lore: The ethereal flames from the ever-burning ruins of Kindertree ignite across realities.

265.name: Infused Raindrops
265.desc:
Passive: Magical Damage Block
Consumes a charge to block 120 magic damage from damage instances over 75 damage.

Comes with 6 charges. When the charges are gone, the item disappears.
notes: Uses at most one charge per damage instance.

244.name: Wind Lace
244.desc: Bonuses from multiple Wind Laces do not stack.
244.lore: Hasten to battle on wind-touched heels.

12.name: Ring of Protection
12.lore: A glimmering ring that defends its bearer.

182.name: Stout Shield
182.desc:
Passive: Damage Block
Grants a 50% chance to block 20 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 8 damage on ranged.
notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
182.lore: One man's wine barrel bottom is another man's shield.

247.name: Moon Shard
247.desc:
Use: Consume
Consume the Moon Shard to permanently gain 60 attack speed and 200 bonus night vision. Max 1 use.

Passive: Shade Sight
Grants bonus night vision.
247.lore: Said to be a tear from the lunar goddess Selemene.

13.name: Gauntlets of Strength
13.lore: Studded leather gloves that add brute strength.

14.name: Slippers of Agility
14.lore: Light boots made from spider skin that tingles your senses.

15.name: Mantle of Intelligence
15.lore: A beautiful sapphire mantle worn by generations of queens.

16.name: Iron Branch
16.desc:
Use: Plant Tree
Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for 20 seconds.
16.lore: A seemingly ordinary branch, its ironlike qualities are bestowed upon the bearer.

17.name: Belt of Strength
17.lore: A valued accessory for improving vitality.

18.name: Band of Elvenskin
18.lore: A tensile fabric often used for its light weight and ease of movement.

19.name: Robe of the Magi
19.lore: This robe corrupts the soul of the user, but provides wisdom in return.

20.name: Circlet
20.lore: An elegant circlet designed for human princesses.

261.name: Crown
261.lore: A stately crown created to ensure a well-meaning but ungifted heir could fend off usurpers and govern with a strong hand.

1122.name: Diadem
1122.lore: A crown that can never be removed.

21.name: Ogre Axe
21.lore: You grow stronger just by holding it.

22.name: Blade of Alacrity
22.lore: A long blade imbued with time magic.

23.name: Staff of Wizardry
23.lore: A staff of magical powers passed down from the eldest mages.

24.name: Ultimate Orb
24.lore: A mystical orb containing the essence of life.

25.name: Gloves of Haste
25.lore: A pair of magical gloves that seems to render weapons weightless.

485.name: Blitz Knuckles
485.lore: An underground arcanist's update of a back-alley classic.

26.name: Morbid Mask
26.desc:
Passive: Lifesteal
Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
26.lore: A mask that drains the energy of those caught in its gaze.

473.name: Voodoo Mask
473.desc:
Passive: Spell Lifesteal
Heals the wearer for a percentage of spell damage dealt to enemies.
notes: Does not heal from Pure or Reflected damage.
473.lore: A mask tuned to sip the arcane bindings that pass between caster and foe.

27.name: Ring of Regen
27.lore: This ring is considered a good luck charm among the Gnomes.

28.name: Sage's Mask
28.lore: A mask commonly used by mages and warlocks for various rituals.

29.name: Boots of Speed
29.desc: Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

30.name: Gem of True Sight
30.desc:
Active: Reveal
Gives True Sight over a 300 radius revealing wards and units even in Fog of War.
Passive: True Sight
Grants the ability to see invisible units and wards to any allied vision within 900 range of its carrier.

Passive: Everlasting
Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.
notes: Disabled while on a courier.
30.lore:
Not one thrall creature of the depths,
Nor spirit bound in drowning's keep,
Nor Maelrawn the Tentacular,
Shall rest till seas, gem comes to sleep.

1848.name: Shawl
notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

31.name: Cloak
notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.
31.lore: A cloak made of a magical material that works to dispel any magic cast on it.

32.name: Talisman of Evasion
notes: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.
32.lore: A necklace that allows you to anticipate enemy attacks.

33.name: Cheese
33.desc:
Use: Fondue
Instantly restores 2500 health and 1500 mana.
notes: Cheese is shareable.
33.lore: Made from the milk of a long lost Furbolg vendor, it restores the vitality of those who taste it.

34.name: Magic Stick
34.desc:
Active: Energy Charge
Instantly restores 15 health and mana per charge stored.

Max 10 charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.
notes: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.
34.lore: A simple wand used to channel magic energies, it is favored by apprentice wizards and great warlocks alike.

36.name: Magic Wand
36.desc:
Active: Energy Charge
Instantly restores 15 health and mana per charge stored.

Max 20 charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.
notes: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.
36.lore: A simple wand used to channel magic energies, it is favored by apprentice wizards and great warlocks alike.

37.name: Ghost Scepter
37.desc:
Active: Ghost Form
You enter ghost form for 4 seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage.
notes: Ends if you become Debuff Immune, and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with all Ghost Scepter upgrades.
37.lore: Imbues the wielder with a ghostly presence, allowing them to evade physical damage.

38.name: Clarity
38.desc:
Use: Replenish
Grants 6 mana regeneration to the target for 25 seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
38.lore: Clear water that enhances the ability to meditate.

216.name: Enchanted Mango
216.desc:
Use: Eat Mango
Instantly restores 100 mana.
notes: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.
216.lore: The bittersweet flavors of Jidi Isle are irresistible to amphibians.

4204.name: Healing Lotus
4204.desc:
Use: Eat Lotus
Instantly restores 125 health and mana.
notes: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

4205.name: Great Healing Lotus
4205.desc:
Use: Eat Lotus
Instantly restores 400 health and mana.
notes: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

4206.name: Greater Healing Lotus
4206.desc:
Use: Eat Lotus
Instantly restores 900 health and mana.
notes: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

1123.name: Blood Grenade
1123.desc:
Use: Throw Grenade
Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take 50 damage on impact, and be slowed by -15% and take 15 damage every 1s for 5s. Radius 300.
1123.lore: Both the hunter and the hunted must pay the blood price.

1942.name: Bloodslinger
1942.desc:
Active: Sling Grenade
Launch a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take 50 damage on impact, and be slowed by -30% and take 15 damage every 1s for 5s. Movement slow decreases over time to -15%. Radius 300.
notes: Shares a cooldown with Blood Grenade.

1154.name: Block of Cheese
1154.lore: First there was the Belt of Strength. Then there were the Boots of Travel. Now, at long last, the Block of Cheese.

39.name: Healing Salve
39.desc:
Use: Salve
Grants 30 health regeneration to the target for 13 seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Heals for half the amount per second when cast on an ally.
39.lore: A magical salve that can quickly mend even the deepest of wounds.

40.name: Dust of Appearance
40.desc:
Use: Reveal
For 12 seconds, creates an area that reveals and slows invisible heroes by -20% in a 1050 radius where the caster was standing. Invisible units revealed by dust take 25 damage.

The debuff effect on enemies lingers for 8s after leaving the area of effect.
notes: Places a debuff on enemy units in the area that reveals them when they are invisible.
40.lore: One may hide visage, but never volume.

41.name: Bottle
41.desc:
Active: Regenerate
Consumes a charge to restore 110 health and 60 mana over 2.7 seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

The Bottle automatically refills at the fountain.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive: Store Rune
Runes can be stored in the Bottle for later use by right-clicking them. Unused runes will automatically activate after 90 seconds.

Using a stored rune fully refills the Bottle.
notes: Bottle is shareable. Stored runes cannot be shared.
Using a stored Bounty or Water rune fully refills the bottle if the bottle was full when the rune was stored; otherwise, it refills two charges.
41.lore: An old bottle that survived the ages, the contents placed inside become enchanted.

42.name: Observer Ward
42.desc:
Use: Plant
Plants an Observer Ward, an invisible watcher that gives ground vision in a 1600 radius to your team. Lasts 6 minutes.

Hold Control to give one Observer Ward to an allied hero.
42.lore: A form of half-sentient plant, often cultivated by apprentice wizards.

43.name: Sentry Ward
43.desc:
Use: Plant
Plants a Sentry Ward, an invisible watcher that grants True Sight, the ability to see invisible enemy units and wards, to any existing allied vision within a 1050 radius.
Lasts 7 minutes.

Does not grant ground vision.
Hold Control to give one Sentry Ward to an allied hero.
43.lore: A form of plant originally grown in the garden of a fearful king.

218.name: Observer and Sentry Wards
218.desc:
Use: Plant
Plant the currently active ward. Double-Click to switch the currently active ward.
notes: Hold Control to give one ward to an allied hero.
218.lore: Advancements in stacking efficiency have made wards easier to carry than ever.

44.name: Tango
44.desc:
Use: Devour
Consumes a target tree to gain 7 health regeneration for 16 seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Comes with 3 charges. Can be used on an allied hero to give them one Tango.

Tree Range: 165
44.lore: Forage to survive on the battlefield.

241.name: Tango (Shared)
241.desc:
Use: Devour
Consumes a target tree to gain 3.5 health regeneration for 16 seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Tree Range: 165

46.name: Town Portal Scroll
46.desc:
Use: Teleport
After channeling for 3 seconds, teleports you to a target friendly building.

Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes: If multiple heroes teleport to the same location in succession, the channeling time will be increased for each successive hero.
Teleport can be prevented or canceled by Root abilities.

48.name: Boots of Travel
48.desc:
Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll
Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

220.name: Boots of Travel 2
220.desc:
Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll
Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units and heroes, reduces cooldown, channel time and does not consume a charge on usage.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

50.name: Phase Boots
50.desc:
Active: Phase
Gives 20% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and 10% on ranged heroes, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly for 3 seconds.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
50.lore: Boots that allow the wearer to travel between the ether.

51.name: Demon Edge
51.lore: One of the oldest weapons forged by the Demon-Smith Abzidian, it killed its maker when he tested its edge.

52.name: Eaglesong
52.lore: Capturing the majestic call of an eagle, this mystical horn brings limitless dexterity to those who hear it.

53.name: Reaver
53.lore: A massive axe capable of tearing whole mountains down.

54.name: Sacred Relic
54.lore: An ancient weapon that often turns the tides of war.

55.name: Hyperstone
55.lore: A mystical, carved stone that boosts the fervor of the holder.

56.name: Ring of Health
56.lore: A shiny ring found beneath a fat halfling's corpse.

279.name: Ring of Tarrasque
279.lore: An ageless ring forged with an otherwise simple blood magic amplified by the presumed source of its key component.

57.name: Void Stone
57.lore: Jewelry that was once used to channel nether realm magic, this ring pulses with energy.

1802.name: Tiara of Selemene
1802.lore: A symbol of favor bestowed upon the high priestess of Selemene.

58.name: Mystic Staff
58.lore: Enigmatic staff made of only the most expensive crystals.

59.name: Energy Booster
59.lore: This lapis gemstone is commonly added to the collection of wizards seeking to improve their presence in combat.

60.name: Point Booster
60.lore: A perfectly formed amethyst that nourishes body and mind when held.

61.name: Vitality Booster
61.lore: A ruby gemstone that has been passed down through generations of warrior kin.

593.name: Fluffy Hat
593.lore: Fine and functional foppery for the fashion-forward fighter.

63.name: Power Treads
63.desc:
Active: Switch Attribute
Switches between +10 Strength, +10 Agility, or +10 Intelligence.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes: Power Treads can be built using a Belt of Strength, Band of Elvenskin, or a Robe of the Magi.
63.lore: A pair of tough-skinned boots that change to meet the demands of the wearer.

1107.name: Phylactery
1107.desc:
Passive: Empower Spell
The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 130 bonus damage to the target and slows them by 40% for 2s.
1107.lore: An amulet overflowing with powerful magics.

1808.name: Khanda
1808.desc:
Passive: Empower Spell
The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 250 additional damage, disables their passives, and slows their movement speed by 30% for 4s.
notes: The slow debuff is dispellable.
The break debuff is not dispellable.
1808.lore: A blade sharp enough to slice through magic itself.

1955.name: Caduceus
1955.desc:
Active: Force
Pushes any target unit 600 units in the direction it is facing, and applies one instance of Empower Spell to them.
Passive: Empower Spell
The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 175 bonus damage to the target and slows them by 40% for 2s.

The next Unit Target spell you cast on an ally heals them for 200 and increases their movement speed by 20% for 2s.
notes: The enemy and ally halves of Empower Spell run on separate cooldowns of 8s and 8s.
Force applies Empower Spell to its target whether or not that half's cooldown is ready, and does not put it on cooldown.
Force doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Force has 850 cast range when cast on enemies.

65.name: Hand of Midas
65.desc:
Active: Transmute
Kills a non-hero target for 160 gold. Killing a neutral creep additionally grants a madstone bundle.

Cannot be used on Ancient creeps.
notes: The gold given is unreliable gold (you do not get the normal creep bounty).
Experience gained by using Transmute is not shared.
65.lore: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owner's pockets.

67.name: Oblivion Staff
67.lore: Deceptively hidden as an ordinary staff, it is actually very powerful, much like the Eldritch who originally possessed it.

534.name: Witch Blade
534.desc:
Passive: Witch Blade
Causes your next attack to apply a poison for 4 seconds, slowing by 25% and dealing 0.75x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike.
notes: Illusions do not apply Witch Blade
534.lore: A spiteful blade inadvertently possessed by the soul of its incautious creator.

69.name: Perseverance
69.lore: A gem that grants heart to the bearer.

1125.name: Cornucopia
1125.lore: A source of spiritual and physical nourishment.

71.name: Poor Man's Shield
71.desc:
Passive: Damage Block
Gives a 100% chance to block 40 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 25 damage on ranged.

Has a 50% chance to block damage from creeps.
notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
71.lore: A busted old shield that seems to block more than it should.

73.name: Bracer
73.lore: The bracer is a common choice to toughen up defenses and increase longevity.

75.name: Wraith Band
75.lore: A circlet with faint whispers echoing about it.

77.name: Null Talisman
77.lore: A small gemstone attached to several chains.

79.name: Mekansm
79.desc:
Active: Restore
Restores 250 health to allied units in a 1200 radius.

Passive: Mekansm Aura
Grants 2.5 health regeneration to allied units in a 1200 radius.
notes: Restore does not affect units that have been affected by Restore or Guardian Greaves Mend within Mekansm's cooldown.
Multiple instances of Mekansm Aura do not stack.
79.lore: A glowing jewel formed out of assorted parts that somehow fit together perfectly.

81.name: Vladmir's Offering
81.desc:
Passive: Vladmir's Aura
Grants 20% lifesteal, 18% bonus damage, 1 mana regeneration, and 1 armor to nearby allies.

Radius: 1200
notes: Lifesteal on attacks against creeps is reduced to 12%.
81.lore: An eerie mask that is haunted with the malice of a fallen vampire.

1944.name: Ristul's Devotion
1944.desc:
Passive: Ristul's Aura
Grants 20% lifesteal, 18% spell lifesteal, 18% bonus damage, 1 mana regeneration, and 2 armor to nearby allies.

Radius: 1200
notes: Lifesteal on attacks against creeps is reduced to 12%.

86.name: Buckler
86.desc:
Passive: Buckler Aura
Grants 1 armor to allied player units.

Radius: 1200
86.lore: A powerful shield that imbues the bearer with the strength of heroes past, it is capable of protecting entire armies in battle.

88.name: Ring of Basilius
88.desc:
Passive: Basilius Aura
Grants 1 mana regeneration to allies.

Radius: 1200
88.lore: Ring given as a reward to the greatest mages.

269.name: Holy Locket
269.desc:
Active: Energy Charge
Target an allied unit to increase their incoming Heal Amplification by 15% for 4s and instantly restore 17 health and 15 mana per charge stored.

Automatically gains a charge every 10 seconds and whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.

Passive: Holy Blessing
Amplifies heals you provide by 10%.
269.lore: A prized relic long thought lost forever in a failed crusade.

90.name: Pipe of Insight
90.desc:
Active: Barrier
Gives a magic damage barrier that absorbs 425 damage to all nearby allies. Lasts 8 seconds.

Radius: 1200

Passive: Insight Aura
Gives allied units 8% magic resistance.

Radius: 1200
notes: Barrier does not affect units that have been affected by Barrier within Pipe of Insight's cooldown.
Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.
90.lore: A powerful artifact of mysterious origin, it creates barriers against magical forces.

92.name: Urn of Shadows
92.desc:
Active: Soul Release
Provides 30 health regeneration when cast on allies, and deals 25 damage per second when cast on enemies.

Lasts 8 seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within 1500 units.
notes: Empty urns gain 2 charges.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
92.lore: Contains the ashes of powerful demons.

94.name: Headdress
94.desc:
Passive: Regeneration Aura
Grants 2 health regeneration to allied player units.

Radius: 1200
94.lore: Creates a soothing aura that restores allies in battle.

96.name: Scythe of Vyse
96.desc:
Active: Hex
Turns a target unit into a harmless critter for 2.8 seconds. The target has a base movement speed of 140 and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed.
Instantly destroys illusions.
notes: The target will have a base movement speed of 140, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.
96.lore: The most guarded relic among the cult of Vyse, it is the most coveted weapon among magi.

98.name: Orchid Malevolence
98.desc:
Active: Soul Burn
Silences the target unit for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, 30% of the damage received while silenced is inflicted as bonus magical damage.
98.lore: A garnet rod constructed from the essence of a fire demon.

250.name: Bloodthorn
250.desc:
Active: Soul Rend
Silences a target for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional 60% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage.

All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to 50 if the attacker is a hero, and 20, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.
250.lore: A reviled blade that bites deeper with each wriggle of its victim's final throes.

252.name: Echo Sabre
252.desc:
Passive: Echo Strike
Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a 100% movement slow for 0.8 seconds on the first strike.
252.lore: A deceptively swift blade imbued with resonant magic.

100.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
100.desc:
Active: Cyclone
Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for 2.5 seconds. Cyclone can only be cast on enemy units or yourself.

Enemy units take 50 magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: You cannot cyclone allies.
Cyclones cast on yourself go through spell immunity.
Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.
100.lore: A mysterious scepter passed down through the ages, its disruptive winds can be used for good or evil.

610.name: Wind Waker
610.desc:
Active: Cyclone
Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for 2.5 seconds. Cyclone can be cast on yourself, enemy units or allied units. When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of 300.

Enemy units take 50 magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
When cast on yourself, the cyclone can be moved anywhere at a speed of 360.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.
610.lore: Proof enough to some that unseen forces manipulate the happenings of the material plane.

232.name: Aether Lens
notes: Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.
232.lore: Polished with the incantation of his final breath, the gift of a dying mage to his sickly son.

102.name: Force Staff
102.desc:
Active: Force
Pushes any target unit 600 units in the direction it is facing.
notes: Force Staff doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Force Staff has 850 cast range when cast on enemies.
102.lore: Allows you to manipulate others, for good or evil.

263.name: Hurricane Pike
263.desc:
Active: Hurricane Thrust
Pushes you and target enemy 425 units away from each other, and for 5 seconds, allows you to make 5 attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +100 attack speed.

Can be cast on self or allies to push the target 600 units in the direction it is facing.
Enemy Range: 425
notes: Self-cast will use Hurricane Pike on yourself.
Hurricane Pike doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Attack Range bonuses from Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.
263.lore: A legendary pike once held as royal sigil of the ancient wyvern riders.

104.name: Dagon
104.desc:
Active: Energy Burst
Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 / 800
Mana Cost: 120 / 140 / 160 / 180 / 200
notes: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.
104.lore: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.

201.name: Dagon
201.desc:
Active: Energy Burst
Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 / 800
Mana Cost: 120 / 140 / 160 / 180 / 200
notes: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.
201.lore: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.

202.name: Dagon
202.desc:
Active: Energy Burst
Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 / 800
Mana Cost: 120 / 140 / 160 / 180 / 200
notes: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.
202.lore: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.

203.name: Dagon
203.desc:
Active: Energy Burst
Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 / 800
Mana Cost: 120 / 140 / 160 / 180 / 200
notes: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.
203.lore: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.

204.desc:

Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit.

Damage: 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 / 800
Mana Cost: 120 / 140 / 160 / 180 / 200
notes: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.
204.lore: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.

106.name: Necronomicon
106.desc:
Active: Demonic Summoning
Summons a Warrior and an Archer to fight for you for 60 seconds.

Warrior:
Burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. Gains True Sight at level 3.
Health: 800 / 1200 / 1600
Damage: 25 / 45 / 65
Mana Break Damage: 30 / 40 / 50
Last Will Damage: 600 / 700 / 800

Archer:
Has a passive movement and attack speed aura. Gains Purge at Level 3.
Health: 800 / 1200 / 1600
Damage: 37 / 57 / 75
Aura Move Speed: 5 / 7 / 9
Aura Radius: 1200
106.lore: Considered the ultimate in necromancy and demonology, a powerful malefic force is locked within its pages.

193.name: Necronomicon
193.desc:
Active: Demonic Summoning
Summons a Warrior and an Archer to fight for you for 60 seconds.

Warrior:
Burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. Gains True Sight at level 3.
Health: 800 / 1200 / 1600
Damage: 25 / 45 / 65

Damage: 37 / 57 / 75
