108.name: Aghanim's Scepter
108.desc:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.
108.lore: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

271.name: Aghanim's Blessing
271.desc:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.
271.lore: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

727.name: Aghanim's Blessing - Roshan
727.desc:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.
727.lore: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

609.name: Aghanim's Shard
609.desc:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades an existing ability or adds a new ability to your hero.
609.lore: With origins known only to a single wizard, fragments of this impossible crystal are nearly as coveted as the renowned scepter itself.

725.name: Aghanim's Shard - Consumable
725.desc:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades an existing ability or adds a new ability to your hero.
725.lore: With origins known only to a single wizard, fragments of this impossible crystal are nearly as coveted as the renowned scepter itself.

1850.name: Eldwurm's Edda
1850.desc:
Passive: Forbidden Knowledge
When consumed, increases Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by 25% of its current value at the time of consumption, and increases the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one. All values except for Mana Cost scale by 50% of the difference between their existing levels for the additional level

110.name: Refresher Orb
110.desc:
Active: Reset Cooldowns
Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Shard. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.
110.lore: A powerful artifact created for wizards.

112.name: Assault Cuirass
112.desc:
Passive: Assault Aura
Grants 30 attack speed and 5 armor to nearby allied units and structures, and decreases nearby enemy unit and structure armor by -5.

Radius: 1200
112.lore: Forged in the depths of the nether reaches, this hellish mail provides an army with increased armor and attack speed.

114.name: Heart of Tarrasque
114.desc:
Passive: Behemoth's Blood
Your health regeneration is increased by 1.5% of your missing health.
notes: Multiple instances of Behemoth's Blood do not stack.
114.lore: Preserved heart of an extinct monster, it bolsters the bearer's fortitude.

116.name: Black King Bar
116.desc:
Active: Avatar
Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Duration: 9 / 8 / 7s
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Purchasing another Black King Bar will not reset its immunity duration.
Avatar duration is not affected by increases to buff duration.
116.lore: A powerful staff imbued with the strength of giants.

117.name: Aegis of the Immortal
117.desc:
Passive: Reincarnation
Brings you to life with full health and mana 5 seconds after you die, at the location where you died.

Reincarnation must be used within 5 minutes or Aegis of the Immortal disappears. If it expires, it will heal you over 5 seconds (dispels on damage).
notes: Pronounced as ayy jis.
117.lore: The Immortal was said to own a shield that protected him from death itself.

119.name: Shiva's Guard
119.desc:
Active: Arctic Blast
Emits a freezing wave that deals 225 magical damage to enemies and slows their movement by -30% for 4 seconds.

Radius: 840

Passive: Freezing Aura
Reduces the attack speed of all enemies by -40.

Radius: 1200
notes: The wave extends at a speed of 400 to a max size of 840.
The Arctic Blast follows its caster.
Multiple instances of Freezing Aura do not stack.
AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.
119.lore: Said to have belonged to a goddess, today it retains much of its former power.

121.name: Bloodstone
121.desc:
Active: Bloodpact
Increases Bloodstone's Spell Lifesteal to 70%. Lasts 5 seconds.

Passive: Spell Weakness Aura
Enemy units take 8% increased damage from spells.

Radius: 1200
notes: Spell Weakness Aura does not stack with Veil of Discord's Spell Weakness.
121.lore: The Bloodstone's bright ruby color is unmistakable on the battlefield, as the owner seems to have infinite vitality and spirit.

123.name: Linken's Sphere
123.desc:
Passive: Spellblock
Blocks most targeted spells once every 14 seconds.

Active: Transfer Spellblock
Temporarily removes Spellblock from the item's owner and transfers it to an allied unit for 14 seconds.
notes: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Spellblock.
123.lore: This magical sphere once protected one of the most famous heroes in history.

226.name: Lotus Orb
226.desc:
Active: Echo Shell
Applies a shield to the target unit for 5 seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster.

The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Echo Shell.
226.lore: The jewel at its center still reflects a pale image of its creator.

223.name: Meteor Hammer
223.desc:
Active: Meteor Hammer
CHANNELED - After a 2s channel, summons a meteor after 0.5s that strikes a 400 AoE, stunning enemies for 0.75s and dealing 150 impact damage. Continues to deal 60 damage per second for 6s.

Non-building units are also slowed by 15% for 6s.

Deals 75% damage to buildings.
223.lore: An enchanted hammer forged of metals discovered in the ruins of a village destroyed by a great star storm.

1946.name: Starforge
1946.desc:
Active: Meteor Hammer
CHANNELED - After a 2s channel, summons a meteor after 0.5s that strikes a 400 AoE, stunning enemies for 0.75s and dealing 150 impact damage. Continues to deal 60 damage per second for 6s.

Non-building units take an additional 15% max health impact damage and are slowed by 15% for 6s.

Deals 75% damage to buildings.

Passive: Celestial Flare
After any of your disables ends on an enemy unit, they burn for 60 damage a second and move 15% slower for 3s.
Celestial Flare can trigger from any of your abilities or items.
Celestial Flare stacks with Meteor Hammer's Burn.
notes: Celestial Flare triggers from the following disables: Stun, Hex, Hypnosis, Cyclone, Taunt, Fear, Sleep, and Banish.

225.name: Nullifier
225.desc:
Active: Nullify
Dispels the target and applies a debuff for 4 seconds. Continuously dispels and slows the target, and the target is less susceptible to forced movement effects applied by their allies.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
225.lore: A dangerous weapon pilfered from an inverse dimension.

256.name: Aeon Disk
256.desc:
Passive: Combo Breaker
When you take damage and your health falls below 70%, a strong dispel is applied and you gain a 2.5 second buff that provides +75% Status Resistance and causes all damage you deal and are dealt to be reduced to zero. Only triggers on player based damage. Cooldown increases every time it triggers.

Dispel Type: Strong Dispel
256.lore: A powerful artifact long ago smuggled out of the Ivory Incubarium. Or so many believe.

259.name: Kaya
notes: Multiple instances of this item do not stack.
259.lore: The staff of a renowned sorceress, lost for countless millennia.

369.name: Trident
369.desc: Combines Sange, Yasha and Kaya together.

260.name: Refresher Shard
260.desc:
Use: Reset Cooldowns
Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Orb. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.
notes: Refresher Shard is shareable.
260.lore: Across an epoch of endless battle, the Immortal's will to triumph never faltered.

267.name: Spirit Vessel
267.desc:
Active: Soul Release
When used against enemies, it reduces health by 4% of current health per second, and reduces Health Restoration by 70%. Deals 25 damage per second.

When used on allies, it provides 40 health regeneration per second.

Lasts 8 seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within 1500 units or the user dies.
notes: Empty vessels gain 2 charges.
Only the closest Spirit Vessel to the dying hero will gain a charge.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
267.lore: Forged by a god to entrap the soul of another.

1852.name: Essence Distiller
1852.desc:
Active: Soul Release
Provides 40 health regeneration when cast on allies.

Can be ground targeted to lie dormant for up to 15s and attach to the first enemy that comes within 450 radius. When on enemies, deals 25 damage per second and provides True Sight over them and shares their vision with the wearer's team.

Lasts 8 seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within 1500 units.
notes: Empty distillers gain 2 charges.
Only the closest Essence Distiller to the dying hero will gain a charge.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
While dormant, provides vision in 450 radius. Vision lingers for 0.5s after latching.

125.name: Vanguard
125.desc:
Passive: Damage Block
Grants a 60% chance to block 50 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 25 damage on ranged.
notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
125.lore: A powerful shield that defends its wielder from even the most vicious of attacks.

242.name: Crimson Guard
242.desc:
Active: Guard
For 7 seconds, grant nearby allied heroes and buildings a 100% chance to block damage equal to 70 plus 2% of the caster's max health value from each incoming attack.

Radius: 1200

Passive: Damage Block
Grants a 60% chance to block 75 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 50 damage on ranged

Passive: Buckler Aura
Grants 2 armor to allied player units.

Radius: 1200
notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
When the Guard buff is applied to ranged heroes, Guard blocks 25 less damage.
Guard does not affect units that have been affected by Guard within Crimson Guard's cooldown.
242.lore: A cuirass originally built to protect against the dreaded Year Beast.

127.name: Blade Mail
127.desc:
Active: Damage Return
For 5.5 seconds, return all incoming damage, increasing the percentage by 85%.

Passive: Damage Return
Everytime you are attacked, you return 10 damage plus 15% of the attack damage dealt to you.
notes: Damage Return is calculated before any kind of reduction.
Returned damage type is the same as it was received.
Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
127.lore: A razor-sharp coat of mail, it is the choice of selfless martyrs in combat.

131.name: Hood of Defiance
131.desc:
Active: Barrier
Creates a spell shield that absorbs up to 350 magical damage. Lasts 12 seconds.
notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.
131.lore: A furred, magic resistant headpiece that is feared by wizards.

692.name: Eternal Shroud
692.desc:
Passive: Shroud
Restores mana equal to 25% of incoming enemy spell damage before reductions.

Passive: Eternal Endurance
For every 300 spell damage that equipped hero receives, it gains a stack of Endurance for 5s up to a maximum of 6 charges. Each charge increases Eternal Shroud's magic resistance by 3.5% .
692.lore: A pristine hood that feeds upon strife to empower its owner.

1854.name: Consecrated Wraps
1854.desc:
Passive: Hallowed
Gain a charge every 4s, up to a maximum of 3 charges. Upon gaining a charge, your movement speed is increased by 15% for 5s.

Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan, consume all charges to gain an all damage barrier for 5s that absorbs 120 damage per charge (360 max).
notes: Charges cannot be gained for 4s after you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan.
Self-damage and HP Loss damage cannot remove charges.
Movement speed buff does not stack.

1856.name: Crella's Crozier
1856.desc:
Active: Rite of Rumusque
You enter ghost form for 4 seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage.

Steal 6% movement speed from enemy heroes in 900 range every second. Movement speed steal lasts 2s.

Putrefaction Aura's effect is increased to 90%. All of the lost Health Restoration is redirected to you every second.

Passive: Putrefaction Aura
Reduces nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration by 30%.

Radius: 900
notes: Ghost form ends if you become Debuff Immune and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Putrefaction Aura does not redirect Health Restoration from enemy heroes that are at full health.

133.name: Divine Rapier
133.desc:
Toggle: Transmute
Toggle to gain either 25% bonus spell amplification or 250 bonus attack damage.

Passive: Everlasting
Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.

Becomes unusable if picked up by an ally of its owner until it is returned to its owner. It is immediately usable by anybody if an enemy of the owner picks it up and is killed. A dropped Rapier cannot be picked up by a courier.
notes: If Divine Rapier is dropped and picked up by an enemy of its original owner, it cannot be dropped again except by death.
Spell Amplification from multiple Rapiers does not stack.
133.lore: So powerful, it cannot have a single owner.

135.name: Monkey King Bar
135.desc:
Passive: Pierce
Grants each attack a 80% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 70 bonus magical damage if the attacker is a hero or 30 if the attacker is an illusion.
135.lore: A powerful staff used by a master warrior.

137.name: Radiance
137.desc:
Toggle: Burn
When active, scorches enemies for 60 magical damage per second. Illusions deal 35 magical damage per second.

Radius: 650
137.lore: A divine weapon that causes damage and a bright burning effect that lays waste to nearby enemies.

139.name: Butterfly
notes: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.
139.lore: Only the mightiest and most experienced of warriors can wield the Butterfly, but it provides incredible dexterity in combat.

141.name: Daedalus
141.desc:
Passive: Critical Strike
Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal 225% damage.
notes: Critical Strike does not work against buildings.
141.lore: A weapon of incredible power that is difficult for even the strongest of warriors to control.

143.name: Skull Basher
143.desc:
Passive: Bash
Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 100 bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.
notes: Does not stack with other sources of Bash.
The following heroes cannot trigger Bash on this item: Spirit Breaker, Faceless Void, Slardar, and Kez while in Sai mode.
Does not grant Bash to Clones, Illusions, or Tempest Doubles.
143.lore: A feared weapon in the right hands, this maul's ability to shatter the defenses of its opponents should not be underestimated.

145.name: Battle Fury
145.desc:
Active: Chop Tree
Destroy a target tree.

Passive: Quell
Increases attack damage against non-hero units by 10 for melee heroes, and 5 for ranged.

Passive: Cleave
Deals 60% of attack damage as physical damage in a cone up to 650 around the target. Deals 40% against creeps. (Melee Only)
notes: Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
If multiple sources of Cleave are present, each Cleave's damage is applied separately.
145.lore: The bearer of this mighty axe gains the ability to cut down swaths of enemies at once.

147.name: Manta Style
147.desc:
Active: Mirror Image
Creates 2 images of your hero that last 18 seconds.

Melee images deal 33% damage, while Ranged images deal 25%. Illusions take 300% damage and have 35% Item Potency.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Has a 0.1 second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
Many effects are removed upon using Manta.
Yasha based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.
147.lore: An axe made of reflective materials that causes confusion amongst enemy ranks.

149.name: Crystalys
149.desc:
Passive: Critical Strike
Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal 160% damage.
notes: Critical Strike does not work against buildings.
149.lore: A blade forged from rare crystals, it seeks weak points in enemy armor.

236.name: Dragon Lance
notes: Attack Range bonuses from Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.
236.lore: The forward charge of the wyvern host grants no quarter.

151.name: Armlet of Mordiggian
151.desc:
Toggle: Unholy Strength
When active, Unholy Strength grants +35 damage, +25 Strength and +4 armor, but drains 45 health per second.

You cannot die from the health drain when Unholy Strength is activated, nor from the strength loss when Unholy Strength is deactivated.
notes: The strength change will affect both maximum and current HP, but you cannot die from the change.
The strength change occurs over 0.6 seconds.
Activating or deactivating Unholy Strength does not interrupt channeling.
151.lore: Weapon of choice among brutes, the bearer sacrifices his life energy to gain immense strength and power.

152.name: Shadow Blade
152.desc:
Active: Shadow Walk
Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell. While Shadow Walk is active, you move 16% faster and can move through units.

If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain 175 bonus physical damage on that attack.
notes: Has a 0.3 second fade time.
If the invisibility ends without attacking, the bonus damage is lost.
152.lore: The blade of a fallen king, it allows you to move unseen and strike from the shadows.

249.name: Silver Edge
249.desc:
Active: Shadow Walk
Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell. While invisible, you move 18% faster and can move through units.

Attacking to end the invisibility will deal 300 bonus physical damage, disable their passive abilities for 5 seconds, and cap their movement speed to 200.
249.lore: Once used to slay an unjust king, only to have the kingdom erupt into civil war in the aftermath.

154.name: Sange and Yasha
notes: Yasha-based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.
154.lore: Sange and Yasha, when attuned by the moonlight and used together, become a very powerful combination.

273.name: Kaya and Sange
273.lore: Two of three known items of unimaginable power that many believe were crafted at the same enchanter's forge.

277.name: Yasha and Kaya
277.lore: Yasha and Kaya when paired together share a natural resonance.

156.name: Satanic
156.desc:
Active: Unholy Rage
Increases Lifesteal percentage to 175% for 6 seconds.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Lifesteal
Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
156.lore: Immense power at the cost of your soul.

158.name: Mjollnir
158.desc:
Active: Static Charge
Places a charged shield on a target unit for 12 seconds which has a 20% chance to release a 225 magical damage shocking bolt at a nearby attacker and 4 additional enemies.

Passive: Chain Lightning
Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 12 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 180 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
notes: Static Charge cannot trigger more than once per second.
Static Charge's shock deals magical damage centered on hero with the Static Charge. Static Charge's targets cannot be more than 900 range away.
Static Charge procs will not bounce to heroes that are invisible or hidden by Fog of War.
Chain Lightning does not trigger off of attacks from illusions.
158.lore: Thor's magical hammer, made for him by the dwarves Brok and Eitri.

160.name: Eye of Skadi
160.desc:
Passive: Cold Attack
Attacks lower enemy movement by -20% if they are melee and -40% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by -25% and Health Restoration by 50%. Lasts for 3 seconds.
160.lore: Extremely rare artifact, guarded by the azure dragons.

162.name: Sange
162.lore: Sange is an unusually accurate weapon, seeking weak points automatically.

164.name: Helm of the Dominator
164.desc:
Active: Dominate
Takes control of one neutral, non-ancient target unit and sets its movement speed to 370 and max health to a minimum of 1000. Also provides the unit with +25 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen and +4 armor.

Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1000 retain their original max health. Grants the caster 50% of the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 100 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Cannot dominate more than one unit at a time.  If a new unit is dominated, the old one will die.
Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
Selling Helm of the Dominator will cause dominated units to die.
164.lore: The powerful headpiece of a dead necromancer.

635.name: Helm of the Overlord
635.desc:
Active: Dominate
Takes control of one neutral target unit and sets its movement speed to 380 and max health to a minimum of 1900. Also provides the unit with +70 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen, +7 armor, and levels up some abilities of the target by 1 level.

Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1900 retain their original max health. Grants the caster the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 250 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
Selling will cause dominated units to die.
635.lore: The powerful headpiece of an undead necromancer.

166.name: Maelstrom
166.desc:
Passive: Chain Lightning
Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 4 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 110 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
notes: Chain Lightning does not trigger off of attacks from illusions.
166.lore: A hammer forged for the gods themselves, Maelstrom allows its user to harness the power of lightning.

1466.name: Gleipnir
1466.desc:
Active: Eternal Chains
Roots all enemies in the target area for 2s.

Radius: 400
notes: AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.
1466.lore: Bindings forged by impossible means to leash an ancient evil.

168.name: Desolator
168.desc:
Passive: Corruption
Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -6 for 7 seconds.

Passive: Soul Stealer
Desolator gains +2 damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of 30.
notes: Armor reduction works on buildings.
168.lore: A wicked weapon, used in torturing political criminals.

170.name: Yasha
notes: Yasha-based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.
170.lore: Yasha is regarded as the swiftest weapon ever created.

172.name: Mask of Madness
172.desc:
Active: Berserk
Gives 100 attack speed, 6% / 12% movement speed (ranged/melee), and 15%/30% slow resistance (ranged/melee), but reduces your armor by 7 and silences you. Lasts 6 seconds.

Passive: Lifesteal
Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
172.lore: Once this mask is worn, its bearer becomes an uncontrollable aggressive force.

174.name: Diffusal Blade
174.desc:
Active: Inhibit
Targets an enemy, slowing it for 4 seconds.

Passive: Manabreak
Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana.
notes: Does not stack with other diffusal blades.
174.lore: An enchanted blade that allows the user to cut straight into the enemy's soul.

1097.name: Disperser
1097.desc:
Active: Suppress
Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for 4 seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and 40% slow resistance for 4 seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.

Both movement speed reduction and increase start at 100% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Manabreak
Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana.
1097.lore: Once entrusted to an Apostle General of the Rumusque Faithful's expeditionary force.

176.name: Ethereal Blade
176.desc:
Active: Ether Blast
Converts the target unit to ethereal form, rendering them immune to physical damage, but unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage.

Enemy targets are also slowed by -80%, and take 1x the sum of all your attributes + 50 as magical damage.
Duration: 4 seconds
notes: Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Ethereal units take -30% bonus magic damage.
176.lore: A flickering blade of a ghastly nature, it is capable of dealing damage in both magical and physical planes.

178.name: Soul Ring
178.desc:
Active: Sacrifice
Consume 170 health to temporarily gain 170 mana. Lasts 10 seconds.

If the mana gained cannot fit in your mana pool, it creates a buffer of mana that will be used before your mana pool.
notes: If this mana is not used before the duration ends, the extra mana is lost.
178.lore: A ring that feeds on the souls of those who wear it.

180.name: Arcane Boots
180.desc:
Active: Replenish
Restores 150 mana to all nearby allies.

Radius: 1200

Passive: Basilius Aura
Grants 1 mana regeneration to allies.

Radius: 1200
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes: Does not work on Meepo clones.
180.lore: Magi equipped with these boots are valued in battle.

235.name: Octarine Core
235.lore: At the core of spellcraft are spectrums only the very gifted can sense.

181.name: Orb of Venom
181.desc:
Passive: Poison Attack
Poisons the target hero, dealing 12 magical damage per second. Lasts for 3 seconds.
notes: Does not stack with its upgrades.
Does not trigger on attacks from illusions.
181.lore: Envenoms your veapon with the venom of a venomous viper.

240.name: Orb of Blight
240.desc:
Passive: Lesser Corruption
Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2 for 3 seconds.
notes: Does not stack with its upgrades, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.
240.lore: An unnerving stone unearthed beneath the Fields of Endless Carnage.

569.name: Orb of Corrosion
569.desc:
Passive: Corrosion
Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2, slows their movement by -16% (-8% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by 18%. Lasts for 3 seconds.
notes: Armor reduction does not stack with its components, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.
Slow and Health Restoration Reduction does not stack with its components or Eye of Skadi.
569.lore: Seepage from the wounds of a warrior deity, sealed in an arcanist's orb following a campaign of vicious slaughter.

1575.name: Orb of Frost
1575.desc:
Passive: Frost
Your attacks slow the target's movement by -13% (-6% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by 15%. Lasts for 3 seconds.
1575.lore: Slowly growing since the universe began, it will envelop everything when it ends.

596.name: Falcon Blade
596.lore: An enchanted blade that long ago raised a hopeless urchin from pauper to king.

598.name: Mage Slayer
598.desc:
Passive: Mage Slayer
Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing 35 physical damage per second and causing them to do 40% less spell damage for 3 seconds.
598.lore: Forged by a secret order in The Third Age of Praxa'cia to fell the False King.

185.name: Drum of Endurance
185.desc:
Active: Endurance
Gives +35 attack speed and +13% movement speed to nearby allies for 6 seconds.

Radius: 1200

Passive: Swiftness Aura
Grants 15 movement speed and 2.5 health regeneration to allies.

Radius: 1200
185.lore: A relic that enchants the bodies of those around it for swifter movement in times of crisis.

931.name: Boots of Bearing
931.desc:
Active: Endurance
Gives +50 attack speed and +15% movement speed to nearby allies for 6 seconds. For the first 1.5 seconds allies are immune to slows.

Radius: 1200

Passive: Swiftness Aura
Grants 15 movement speed and 2.5 health regeneration to allies.

Radius: 1200
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
931.lore: Resplendent footwear fashioned for the ancient herald that first dared spread the glory of Stonehall beyond the original borders of its nascent claim.

187.name: Medallion of Courage
187.desc:
Active: Valor
Increases armor by 10 or decreases armor by -6 for 8s depending on if cast on an ally or enemy. Cannot be cast on self.

229.name: Solar Crest
229.desc:
Active: Shine
When cast on an ally, grants them 5 armor, 60 attack speed, 15% movement speed and a 350 physical damage barrier.

Bonus armor, movement and attack speed have 50% effectiveness when cast on self.

Duration: 7
notes: Shares cooldown with Pavise.
229.lore: A talisman forged to honor the daytime sky.

1128.name: Pavise
1128.desc:
Active: Protect
When cast on an ally, grants them a physical damage barrier that absorbs 250 damage. Duration: 7s.
1128.lore: Devised by a wizard who made one too many enemies.

188.name: Smoke of Deceit
188.desc:
Use: Disguise
Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled targets in a 1200 radius invisible, and grants 25% bonus movement speed for 50 seconds.

While the caster is still disguised, any allies that come within 300 range of them will also get the buff applied to them. Each smoke can only be applied once to allies.

Attacking or moving within 1025 range of an enemy hero or tower, will break the invisibility.

Disguise grants invisibility that is immune to True Sight.

Smoke of Deceit is usable from the backpack and has no cooldown when swapped into the main inventory.
188.lore: The charlatan wizard Myrddin's only true contribution to the arcane arts.

257.name: Tome of Knowledge
257.desc:
Use: Enlighten
Grants you 750 experience plus 150 per tome consumed by your team after the first two.

Tomes Used By Team: ?
257.lore: That which raises beast to man and man to god.

190.name: Veil of Discord
190.desc:
Active: Spell Weakness
Cast a 900 radius blast that causes enemy heroes to take 8% increased damage from spells.

Can be cast while channeling.

Duration: 16 seconds.
notes: Spell Weakness does not stack with Bloodstone's Spell Weakness Aura.

1806.name: Parasma
1806.desc:
Passive: Witch Blade
Causes your next attack to apply a poison for 4 seconds, slowing by 25% and dealing 0.85x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike and can affect buildings. Deals 40% damage to buildings.

Passive: Magic Corruption
Your attacks reduce the enemy's Magic resistance by 15% for 4 seconds.
notes: Illusions do not apply Witch Blade, but can apply Magic Corruption
1806.lore: Warning: There is no antidote if picked up by the wrong end.

231.name: Guardian Greaves
231.desc:
Active: Mend
Restores 325 health and 200 mana to nearby allies, and removes most negative effects from the caster.

Radius: 1200
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Guardian Aura
Grants 2.5 health regeneration and 1.5 mana regeneration to allied units.

Radius: 1200
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes: Mend does not affect units that have been affected by Mend or Mekansm Restore within Guardian Greaves' cooldown.
231.lore: One of many holy instruments constructed to honor the Omniscience.

206.name: Rod of Atos
206.desc:
Active: Cripple
Roots the target for 2 seconds.
206.lore: Atos, the Lord of Blight, has his essence stored in this deceptively simple wand.

239.name: Iron Talon
239.desc:
Active: Chop
Targets a non-player enemy unit to remove 45% of its current HP.

If cast on a tree, instantly destroys it.
notes: Has a 4 second cooldown on Trees.
239.lore: A simple but effective weapon devised to quell a great Hellbear uprising.

208.name: Abyssal Blade
208.desc:
Active: Overwhelm
Stuns a target enemy unit for 1.6 seconds.

Pierces Debuff Immunity.

Passive: Bash
Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 120 bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.
notes: The stun is melee range.
Does not stack with other bashes, and does not grant bash to Clones, Illusions, or Tempest Doubles.
The following heroes cannot trigger Bash on this item: Spirit Breaker, Faceless Void, Slardar, and Kez while in Sai mode.
Attack Range bonuses from Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.
208.lore: The lost blade of the Commander of the Abyss, this edge cuts into an enemy's soul.

210.name: Heaven's Halberd
210.desc:
Active: Disarm
Prevents a target from attacking for 3 seconds.
210.lore: This halberd moves with the speed of a smaller weapon, allowing the bearer to win duels that a heavy edge would not.

1948.name: Skypiercer
1948.desc:
Active: Disarm
Prevents a target from attacking for 3 seconds.

Passive: Riposte
Whenever you are within 500 range of an enemy hero, Disarm gains 125% cooldown acceleration.
notes: Nearby illusions and nearby heroes in fog of war will activate Riposte.
Nearby invisible heroes will not activate Riposte.

212.name: Ring of Aquila
212.desc:
Passive: Aquila Aura
Grants 1.75 mana regeneration and 3 armor to nearby allies.

Radius: 1200
Toggle: Aura
Deactivate to stop affecting non-hero units.
notes: Multiple instances of Aquila Aura do not stack.
212.lore: The ring of the fallen Warlord Aquila continues to support armies in battle.

214.name: Tranquil Boots
214.desc:
Passive: Respite
Whenever you attack a hero or are attacked by any unit, the health regen bonus is reduced to 2 and the movement speed bonus is reduced to 40 for 13 seconds.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
214.lore: While they increase the longevity of the wearer, this boot is not particularly reliable.

215.name: Shadow Amulet
215.desc:
Active: Fade
Grants invisibility to you or a target allied hero for 3.5s. Movement speed during the invisibility is reduced by 35%.
notes: Takes 1.25s of the 3.5s for the hero to fully fade into invisibility.
215.lore: A small talisman that clouds the senses of one's enemies when held perfectly still.

254.name: Glimmer Cape
254.desc:
Active: Glimmer
After a 0.5 second delay, grants invisibility, 20 movement speed and a magic damage barrier that absorbs up to 375 damage to you or a target allied unit for 5 seconds.

Can be cast while channeling.
254.lore: The stolen cape of a master illusionist.

287.name: Keen Optic
287.lore: Stolen from a tinker's shop ages ago, this handy lens has seen service to many owners.

288.name: Grove Bow
288.desc:
Passive: Magic Amp
Reduces magic resistance of the attacked enemy by 20%.
288.lore: A gift from the moon goddess to one of her prized disciples many memories ago.

289.name: Quickening Charm
289.desc:
Passive: Cooldown Reduction
Reduces the cooldown time of all spells and items.
289.lore: An evergreen amulet of druidic origins.

290.name: Philosopher's Stone
290.lore: A weightless charm created by an enchanter with a powerful scorn for brute force.

291.name: Force Boots
291.desc:
Active: Force
Pushes the target 750 units in the direction they are facing. Dispels if cast on an ally.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Speed Unlock
Completely removes the speed limit for the wearer
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
291.lore: Elusive marvels never successfully studied for proper classification in the archives.

292.name: Stygian Desolator
292.desc:
Passive: Greater Corruption
Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -13 for 7 seconds.
notes: Armor reduction works on buildings.
292.lore: The original demonic favorite that served as basis for the beloved mortal design.

293.name: Phoenix Ash
293.desc:
Passive: Rebirth
Lethal damage is prevented and instead the wearer is healed to half health and non-ultimate ability cooldowns reset. Gets consumed on trigger.

294.name: Seer Stone
294.desc:
Active: Reveal
Reveal a target 800 area of the map for 6 seconds.
294.lore: The curious creation of a wizard who professed to hail from another time.

302.name: Elixir
302.desc:
Use: Consume
Restores 500 health and 250 mana to the target over 6 seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

829.name: Arcanist's Armor
829.desc:
Active: Mega Shield
Force Field Aura Grants 25% Damage Reflection for 5 seconds.

Passive: Shield
Grants +4 armor and +8% Magic Resistance to all other allies within 1200 radius.
notes: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
829.lore: An exquisite piece commissioned by a paranoid monarch who choked on a piece of fruit long before the item saw its intended use.

834.name: Blast Rig
834.desc:
Passive: Hair Trigger
The next time you get attacked by a hero within 400 range, explode dealing 250 damage to all enemies within a 400 radius and causing them to miss 100% of their attacks for 2 seconds.
834.lore: One of a set of custom rigs once worn by infamous road agents in the Outlands, its siblings have been lost to misfires and the various tides of time.

298.name: Craggy Coat
298.desc:
Active: Toughen Up
Grants you an extra 6 bonus armor at the cost of -20 movement speed. Lasts 6 seconds.

300.name: Timeless Relic
300.desc: Increases all outgoing spell damage and debuff duration.
300.lore: An unmarred discovery from the excavated ruins of an ancient wizard's academy.

301.name: Mirror Shield
301.desc:
Passive: Echo Shield
Block and reflect most targeted spells back to their caster once every 12 seconds.
301.lore: The shield that long ago robbed the old one of his first memories.

304.name: Ironwood Tree
304.desc:
Use: Plant Tree
Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for 20 seconds.
304.lore: Precious. And hearty as a weed.

328.name: Mango Tree
328.desc:
Use: Plant a Mango Tree
Targets the ground to plant a mango tree that provides unlimited mango power. The tree generates Enchanted Mangoes every 60 seconds, and provides unobstructed vision in the area .

305.name: Royal Jelly
305.desc:
Active: Consume
Consumes all charges and grants a target allied unit a buff that provides +2.5 Health Regen and +1.25 Mana Regen per charge for 8s.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
305.lore: To those who harvest olgru jelly, success serves more than mere profit--it's often the means to survival--for only the jelly itself can cure the ravages that follow a sting from the vigilant denizens of the giant hives.

306.name: Pupil's Gift
notes: Grants two-thirds value to each attribute for Universal Heroes
306.lore: An astounding plate of ever-replenishing, fortifying fruit.

307.name: Tome of Aghanim
307.desc:
Use: Consume
Temporarily grants an allied target the Aghanim's Scepter buff for 3 minutes.

308.name: Repair Kit
308.desc:
Use: Building Repair
Targets a building, restoring 40% of it's health over 30 seconds. Also grants +10 armor during this period.

309.name: Mind Breaker
309.desc:
Passive: Silence Strike
The next attack silences the hit enemy for 2 seconds.
309.lore: A bewitching blade of indeterminate form capable of piercing the psyche of even the most willful foe.

310.name: Third Eye
310.desc:
Passive: True Sight
Grants the ability to see invisible units and wards to any allied vision within 500 range of its carrier.
Passive: Charge Loss
Loses a charge on death. After all charges are lost, the item disappears.

311.name: Spell Prism
311.desc:
Passive: Cooldown Reduction
Reduces the cooldown time of all spells and items.
311.lore: Even the slightest flaw in the components of a spell prism can result in the death of its user.

325.name: Prince's Knife
325.desc:
Passive: Hex Strike
The next attack hexes the hit enemy into a frog for 1.5 seconds.

330.name: Witless Shako
330.desc: Increases the wearer's max health, while reducing their max mana.

334.name: Imp Claw
334.desc:
Passive: Critical Strike
Empowers your next attack, causing it to be a critical strike dealing 130% damage.
334.lore: Though their tasks are largely thankless, demon hunters can often turn a profit bartering parts in Weeping Rose.

335.name: Flicker
335.desc:
Active: Flicker
Dispells debuffs and blinks you in a random forward direction for a random distance between 200 and 600. If cast within 3 seconds of receiving player damage, it will blink in place.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
335.lore: The technically-true-to-his-word 'teleportation device' crafted by a notorious fae trickster.

336.name: Telescope
336.desc:
Passive: Prescient Aura
Lowers Scan cooldown by 50% . Increases attack range (Ranged only) and cast range of allies in a 1200 unit radius.
336.lore: A handy tool that manages to make close what once was far.

326.name: Spider Legs
326.desc:
Active: Skitter
Grants you 25% bonus movement speed, 50% improved turn rate, and free pathing for 12 seconds. Walking over trees causes them to be destroyed.
326.lore: A horrifying yet useful mixture of necromancy and artificing.

327.name: Helm of the Undying
327.desc:
Passive: Death Delay
Survive for an extra 6 seconds after receiving a killing blow. If any enemy heroes dies within 1200 units, the death delay effect is extended by 5 seconds. The hero cannot attack buildings during Death Delay.
327.lore: The price for wearing it is paid in the afterlife.

331.name: Vambrace
331.desc:
Active: Switch Attributes
Activate to switch the active attribute between Strength, Agility, and Intelligence. Vambrace provides +10 of the selected attribute and +4 of the other two attributes.
331.lore: The coveted treasure that divided the heirs of Queen Raiya upon her death, resulting in the eventual downfall of her kingdom.

313.name: Fusion Rune
313.desc:
Use: Consume
Grants the target the bonuses of every Power Rune for 50 seconds. Each use consumes a charge.

354.name: Ocean Heart
354.desc:
Passive: Water Regen
Provides you with 10 HP regen and 5 mana regen while in the river.
354.lore: A charm blessed by the Council of the Brine.

1124.name: Spark of Courage
1124.desc:
Passive: Courage
Provides 10 damage when the hero is above 50% Health, and 5 armor when they are below that threshold.
1124.lore: A common battle charm in the armies that served the Children of Light.

355.name: Broom Handle
355.lore: The surprisingly dangerous creation of an apprentice sorcerer with a strange fondness for brooms.

356.name: Trusty Shovel
356.desc:
Active: Dig
Channel for 1 second.
Can find a Bounty Rune, a Healing Salve, an Enchanted Mango, or a Kobold. If digging in a river, always digs up a Water Rune.
notes: 16% chance for a Bounty Rune.
28% chance each for a Flask, an Enchanted Mango, or a kobold.
The same Trusty Shovel cannot find the same reward twice in a row.
356.lore: Former plaything of a young deity, received as a gift from his uncle.

357.name: Nether Shawl
357.lore: An otherworldly garment tethered to our plane by unknown means.

358.name: Dragon Scale
358.desc:
Passive: Afterburn
Causes attacks to burn the enemy, dealing 22 damage per second for 3 seconds. Affects buildings.
358.lore: The remains of a dragon always outvalue the wealth of even the most prodigious hoard.

359.name: Essence Ring
359.desc:
Active: Life Essence
Increases your current and max health by 240 for 14 seconds.
359.lore: An ancient bauble blessed by the breath of Verodicia.

360.name: Clumsy Net
360.desc:
Active: Ensnare
Ensnares the target enemy and yourself for 1.75 seconds.

361.name: Enchanted Quiver
361.desc:
Passive: Certain Strike
Empowers your next attack with 250 bonus magical damage and True Strike. Ranged Attackers have +350 bonus range for the attack.
361.lore: A graceful gift blessed by the goddess of the hunt.

362.name: Ninja Gear
362.desc:
Active: Solitary Disguise
Casts Smoke of Deceit on yourself only that lasts for up to 15 seconds.
362.lore: Valuable equipment recovered by a young explorer sifting through the flotsam and detritus drifting in the void.

363.name: Illusionist's Cape
363.desc:
Active: Create Illusion
Creates an image under your control.
Passive: Illusion Mastery
Increases outgoing damage of all units and illusions controlled by the hero by 6%.
363.lore: A dashing cape whose creator insists on calling 'Cloak of Apparition' as opposed to his assistant's 'Illusion' drivel.

364.name: Havoc Hammer
364.desc:
Active: Havoc
Pulls enemies in a 400 range around you, slowing them by 50% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 + 1.5x your str as magical damage.

365.name: Magic Lamp
365.desc:
Passive: Rejuvenate
When the wearer's health falls below 20%, they will receive a strong dispel and be healed for 1500 health.

Dispel Type: Strong Dispel

366.name: Apex
notes: Grants +24 to each attribute for Universal Heroes.
366.lore: Three orbs of remarkable power bound within a single scepter.

367.name: Ballista
367.desc:
Passive: Knockback
Knocks back enemies 50 distance and deals 50 pure damage with every attack.
367.lore: A simple design much improved by a master smith's loving hand.

368.name: Woodland Striders
368.desc:
Active: Woodland Stride
Create a path of trees behind you for 3 seconds. Trees last up to 15 seconds.
Passive: Tree Walking
Removes movement speed limit and allows free pathing through trees.

Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

370.name: Book of the Dead
370.desc:
Active: Greater Demonic Summoning
Summon 2 demonic warriors and 2 demonic archers that last 65 seconds. The Warrior burns mana every hit and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. The Archer has a basic dispel ability with a slow and a passive movement speed aura.
notes: The Demonic Warrior has 1600 Health, 4 Armor, 40% Magic Resistance, 380 Movement Speed, 134 Attack Damage, 50 Mana Burn on Hit, and deals 800 Damage on Death.
The Demonic Archer has 1300 Health, 4 Armor, 40% Magic Resistance, 425 Movement Speed, 131 Attack Damage, a basic dispel ability with a slow on a 15s Cooldown, and a 9% Bonus Movement Speed Aura.
370.lore: A record of the final reckoning. With one page torn out.

371.name: Fallen Sky
371.desc:
Active: Fallen Sky
Transform into a meteor that strikes down at the target area after 1 seconds in a 315 AoE, stunning enemies for 1.6 seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage every 1 seconds to enemy units and buildings for 6 seconds.Building Impact Damage: 110 Building Over Time Damage: 60 Non-Building Impact Damage: 150 Non-Building Over Time Damage: 60

Fallen Sky cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
371.lore: One of the few surviving creations of the acolytes of the Wyrmforge.

372.name: Pirate Hat
372.desc:
Passive: Plunder
Steals 150 gold from enemy heroes that die within 2400 units. If the wearer is the killer, there is no range limit and an additional 400 gold is stolen.
Passive: Buried Treasure
Gold loss on death reduced by 100%.
372.lore: A salty skulltopper cursed with endless good fortune.

374.name: Ex Machina
374.desc:
Active: Reset Cooldowns
Reset the cooldown on all items (except Refresher Orb).
374.lore: The remains of an ancient universe, preserved within a single sphere.

375.name: Faded Broach
375.lore: A life-saving jewel bestowed upon a young queen by a kindly vizier.

376.name: Paladin Sword
376.lore: The sigil blade of the legendary Brother Yhols of Gausra, stripped from its scabbard on the day of his controversial excommunication.

377.name: Minotaur Horn
377.desc:
Active: Lesser Avatar
Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage for 3s. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
377.lore: The trophy from a mighty beast ambushed and slain in the recesses of its own home.

378.name: Orb of Destruction
378.desc:
Passive: Impeding Corruption
Attacks reduce the target's armor and movement speed. Slow amount varies based on whether the wearer is melee or ranged.
378.lore: An ingot of chaos suspended in wizard's ether, housed within an arcanist's orb.

379.name: The Leveller
379.desc:
Passive: Level
Attacks deal 35% more damage to buildings.
379.lore: A demonic blade that struck the final blow to crack the gates of the Sanctum of Solanas.

349.name: Arcane Ring
349.desc:
Active: Replenish Mana
Restores mana equal to 30 + 3% of the caster's maximum mana pool to all nearby allies.

Radius: 1200
349.lore: Once a prized heirloom of a minor lord's house.

381.name: Titan Sliver
381.lore: Though many desire this brilliant shard for its obvious qualities, a school of study exists to determine the true size and purpose of its incomprehensible whole.

565.name: Chipped Vest
565.desc:
Passive: Chipper
Every time you are attacked, you return 40 damage to heroes and 20 damage to creeps.
notes: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
565.lore: It doesn't look like much, but it's oddly comfy.

573.name: Elven Tunic
573.lore: Even simple items of elven make seem imbued with inexplicable efficacy.

574.name: Cloak of Flames
574.desc:
Passive: Immolate
Burns enemy units in a 375 unit radius for 40 damage per second. Illusions deal 25 damage per second.
574.lore: A very fine cloak that plays host to an overly-protective living flame.

571.name: Trickster Cloak
571.desc:
Active: Cloak
Causes you to become invisible for 6 seconds.
571.lore: A fantastic garment immediately misplaced by its creator upon completion.

577.name: Possessed Mask
577.desc:
Passive: Lifesteal
Heals the attacker for 7 HP on each attack.
notes: Grants 1/3rd of the value to each attribute for Universal Heroes.
577.lore: Even when discarded with specific purpose and great care, this frightening mask always finds its way onto the face of a new owner.

638.name: Penta-Edged Sword
638.desc:
Passive: Maim
Each attack has a 25% chance to reduce enemy hero movement speed by 20% and attack speed by 60 for 3 seconds.
638.lore: The final, twisted work of a severely pious blacksmith, completed immediately before the taking of his own life.

680.name: Bullwhip
680.desc:
Active: Whip
Grants 25% movement speed when cast on allies, and slows by 25% when cast on enemies. Lasts 4 seconds.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
680.lore: Once the favored lash of an infamous broker of pit fighters and other live trade.

675.name: Psychic Headband
675.desc:
Active: Psychic Push
Pushes the target unit away from you 400 distance.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
675.lore: A failed experiment in finer telekinetic control, still fit for other ends.

676.name: Ceremonial Robe
676.desc:
Passive: Ceremonial Aura
Lowers enemy Status Resistance by 10% and Magic Resistance by 10%.

Radius: 850
676.lore: One of many items lost in the looting of Zelenwyr's sacred reliquary.

686.name: Quicksilver Amulet
686.desc:
Passive: Quicksilver
Grants you a bonus 5% movement speed and 20 attack speed anytime one of your abilities are on cooldown.
686.lore: An enchanted talisman brimming with a mysterious substance.

677.name: Book of Shadows
677.desc:
Active: Shadows
Target an enemy, ally or self. Causes the target to become untargetable from enemies to the caster, but also silenced, muted and disarmed for 4 seconds. Applies a Basic Dispel.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
677.lore: An impossible tome filled with unreadable prose of unknowable thoughts.

678.name: Giant's Ring
678.desc:
Passive: Giant's Foot
Can path over any terrain and deals 100% of your strength per second to units you are standing ontop of.
678.lore: Prized procurement of an otherwise unremarkable ruler of Elze who abdicated his position and vanished.

585.name: Stormcrafter
585.desc:
Passive: Bottled Lightning
Zaps 2 enemy targets within 700 range, dealing 90 damage and a 40% slow for 0.4 seconds.
585.lore: The accidental byproduct of a spell conjured to entrap a lesser god.

589.name: Fairy's Trinket
589.lore: A small token imbued with the fortune of the fae in recognition of an intriguing display of mortal kindness.

825.name: Ascetic's Cap
825.desc:
Passive: Endurance
Whenever a debuff would be applied to the owner, grant ?% Status resistance and ?% Slow Resistance for ? seconds.
825.lore: An austere hat thought to be of Turstarkuri origin.

828.name: Brigand's Blade
828.desc:
Passive: Dark Mercy
Your attacks deal 7 more damage to enemies for each 10% HP they are missing.
828.lore: An infamous assassin's blade stolen and smuggled out of White Spire after its owner's mysterious demise.

837.name: Witchbane
837.desc:
Active: Cleanse
Dispel all enemies and allies in a 300 unit radius.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Subjugate
Your attacks deal bonus magical damage equal to 4% of your target's Max Mana.
837.lore: With ready access to test subjects, untold cruelties have been dreamed up and loosed upon the world from within the walls of the Tyler Estate.

838.name: Pig Pole
838.desc:
Active: Pig, Out!
Turns your hero into a critter for 3 seconds and gives them +20% Movement Speed.
838.lore: A makeshift charm misplaced by a peace-loving, addlebrained enchanter.

840.name: Tumbler's Toy
840.desc:
Active: Vault
Propels your hero forward 350 units. Tumbler's Toy gets disabled for 3 seconds if its owner receives damage from a player source.
840.lore: An antique plaything found in the ruins of an Ozenja circus bazaar.

835.name: Fae Grenade
835.desc:
Active: Shadow Brand
Throws a Mark towards an enemy within 900 range applying a debuff that deals 40 damage every second and provides vision of the unit for 7 seconds.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
835.lore: Those marked for death by the fae shine brightly to all manner of creatures in the shadow realm.

945.name: Seeds of Serenity
945.desc:
Active: Verdurous Dale
Target the ground with a 400 radius. Provides health regeneration to all allied units while they are in the area of effect equal to 3 + 25% of the caster's health regeneration at the time of casting. Lasts 8 seconds.
945.lore: An evergreen sprout treasured by the woodkin and highly coveted by interlopers and their like.

946.name: Lance of Pursuit
946.desc:
Passive: Hound
Attacking from behind slows enemies by 16% (8% if Ranged) and deals 20 more damage. Slow lasts 2 second(s).
946.lore: The gleaming weapon of a tarnished knight haunted by his duties to an unworthy king.

947.name: Occult Bracelet
947.desc:
Passive: Rites of Eloshar
Each time the wearer is attacked, they gain a stack of 0.4 mana regen, up to 8 stacks. Stacks last for 6 seconds.
947.lore: A band that bears effigy of the dark goddess Eloshar's unsleeping eye.

949.name: Ogre Seal Totem
949.desc:
Active: Ogre Seal Flop
Flop forward like an ogre seal 2 times, dealing 250 damage and slowing enemies in a 275 radius by -100% for 1.5 second on each bounce. 400 bounce distance.

939.name: Harpoon
939.desc:
Active: Draw Forth
When targeting an enemy, fire a harpoon at them, that pulls you and the target closer together, up to 35% of the distance between you and your target. If the caster is melee, the hero and target are always pulled to within melee distance of each other. Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.

Passive: Echo Strike
Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a 100% movement slow for 1 seconds on the first strike. Echo Strike cooldown: 5s
notes: Attack Range bonuses from Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.
939.lore: A perfect solution for the flight of foes.

950.name: Defiant Shell
950.desc:
Passive: Reciprocity
When attacked, the hero counter-attacks a target within their attack range for 80% of their regular attack damage.

990.name: Eye of the Vizier
990.lore: The ring of a cunning court mage who imprisoned a cadre of enemies to serve as his personal mana reserve.

1077.name: Dagger of Ristul
1077.desc:
Active: Imbrue
Consume health to temporarily gain 30 damage for 10 seconds.
1077.lore: A sinister shiv that grants favor to those willing to stain its blade with a sacrifice of their own blood.

4300.name: Beloved Memory
4300.desc:
Active: Honor the Dead
Place this Offering on an Altar to honor the dead with a memory from those they left behind.
4300.lore: Take joy in remembering those beloved who've passed now beyond the veil.

4301.name: Scrying Shovel
4301.desc:
Active: Dig
Search the map for Offerings to the dead.
4301.lore: You don't know where it came from, but it knows where you need to go. All you need to do is dig.

4302.name: Forebearer's Fortune
4302.desc:
Active: Undying Promise
Signal to the spirits of the other realm your commitment to honoring them. If everyone in the battle makes an Undying Promise before the fight begins, the dead might be willing to listen.
4302.lore: This item seems unstable. Like it might just disappear.

1090.name: Mercy & Grace
1090.desc:
Active: Dead Shot
Fires a ghostly bullet at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes it will deal 300 damage and slow the target by -100% for 0.5 seconds, then ricochet in the vector-targeted direction. The ricochet will damage all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet will be feared for 2 seconds in the direction of the shot.
notes: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel 1x Dead Shot's cast range.
1090.lore: One to deliver the body, the other to claim the soul.

2091.name: Tier 1 Token
2091.desc: Activate to redeem a Tier 1 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.

2092.name: Tier 2 Token
2092.desc: Activate to redeem a Tier 2 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.

2093.name: Tier 3 Token
2093.desc: Activate to redeem a Tier 3 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.

2094.name: Tier 4 Token
2094.desc: Activate to redeem a Tier 4 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.

2095.name: Tier 5 Token
2095.desc: Activate to redeem a Tier 5 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.

2096.name: Vindicator's Axe
2096.desc:
Passive: Vengeance
Provides 30 damage if equipped hero is Silenced and 20 armor if equipped hero is Stunned.

911.name: Revenant's Brooch
911.desc:
Passive: Ghastly Strike
Grants each attack a 15% chance to deal an additional 50% of the attack's damage as bonus magical damage.
notes: Counts as a critical strike, and so does not stack with other critical strikes.
Does not work against buildings.

2097.name: Duelist Gloves
2097.desc:
Passive: Boldness
Grants 26 attack speed as long as there are enemy heroes within 1200 units.

1156.name: Ancient Guardian
1156.desc:
Passive: Ancient Power
Grants 50 extra bonus damage as long as the unit is within 2000 range of an ancient.

1157.name: Safety Bubble
1157.desc:
Passive: Bubbled Up
Equipped Hero has a 125 HP Barrier against enemy damage. Barrier fully regenerates after not receiving damage for 8 seconds. Self-inflicted damage bypasses the barrier.

1158.name: Whisper of the Dread
1158.desc:
Passive: Tunnel Vision
Equipped Hero has their daytime vision reduced by 15% but their Spell damage increased by 10%.
1158.lore: The air that passes through this amulet makes a dreadful sound.

1159.name: Nemesis Curse
1159.desc:
Passive: Glass Cannon
Hero takes 6% more damage from all sources.
Passive: Glassify
When attacking a hero, apply a debuff increasing the damage received by that hero by 12% for 5 seconds. Only one target can be affected by Glassify at the same time.

1160.name: Aviana's Feather
1160.desc:
Passive: Free Bird
When equipped hero is below 30% HP, they gain flying movement.

1161.name: Unwavering Condition
1161.desc:
Passive: Unwavering
Hero's Max Health is set to 1800 and can't be altered by other effects or attributes.

2190.name: Dandelion Amulet
2190.desc:
Passive: Magical Damage Block
Every 10s, blocks up to 300 magic damage from damage instances over 75 damage.

2192.name: Martyr's Plate
2192.desc:
Active: Martyrdom
Redirect 25% of all magic damage dealt to your allied heroes within 900 radius towards you for 10 seconds.
notes: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

2193.name: Gossamer Cape
2193.desc:
Passive: Sixth Sense
Automatically dodge an attack from an enemy hero.

1167.name: Light Collector
1167.desc:
Active: Lightbreak
Produce a brilliant flash of light that destroys trees in a 325 AoE.

Passive: Unclouded
Provides wearer with health regeneration during the day and mana regeneration during the night. When within a 200 distance of any trees, health and mana regeneration are decreased by 75%.

1168.name: Rattlecage
1168.desc:
Passive: Reverberate
After taking 220 damage from any source, the wearer fires a projectile at up to 2 random enemies in a 600 radius, prioritizing heroes, that deal 110 physical damage and slow the targets movement and attack speed by 100% for 0.2s.
notes: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

1803.name: Doubloon
1803.desc:
Toggle: Flip
Toggle to convert 30% of your Max Health to Max Mana, or 30% of your Max Mana to Max Health.

1804.name: Roshan's Banner
1804.desc:
Use: Place Banner
Creates a banner at the target location. Lane creeps in the area of effect become damage immune while the Banner is up. Lasts 120 seconds.

Can be destroyed. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the banner.
notes: The banner has fragile pips: melee heroes and Roshan remove 2 pips per attack.

1949.name: Stone of Recall
1949.desc:
Use: Place Stone
Plants a Stone of Recall at the target location, active the moment it lands. Allied heroes anywhere on the map can channel on the stone to teleport to it.

The stone lasts 60 seconds. It is immune to spells and has 6 pip health. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to it.
1949.lore: A shard chipped from one of the ancient waystones, still remembering the road home.

1950.name: Horn of Battle
1950.desc:
Use: Call to Arms
Target an allied barracks anywhere on the map to summon a wave of mega creeps, including a catapult and a flagbearer, in that lane for your team. Can be used from the backpack.

1951.name: Greater Horn of Battle
1951.desc:
Use: Grand Call to Arms
Summons a wave of mega creeps, including a catapult and a flagbearer, in every lane for your team. Can be used from the backpack.

1440.name:
Black Grimoire
(Warlock)
1440.desc:
Use: Profane Knowledge
Hero kills and assists empower the Black Grimoire, granting it charges. Right-click to consume and grant 200 experience per charge. Starts on cooldown.
This item cannot be dropped.

1441.name: Gris-Gris
1441.desc: This item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack but can be put into normal inventory slots. When the owner dies, 100% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

1588.name: Fleetfooted
notes: Does not stack with Movement Speed bonuses from boots

1596.name: Evolved
notes: Grants +12 to each attribute for Universal Heroes.

1598.name: Unrelenting Eye
1598.desc:
Passive: Relentless
Increases slow resistance by 60%. This bonus is reduced by 12% for every enemy hero within the wearer's attack radius.
1598.lore: A serpent's eye the size of a melon (and just as moist).

1599.name: Mana Draught
1599.desc:
Active: Bottoms Up
Restores 90 + 3% of the caster's maximum mana over 6 seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive: Fill Up
Cooldown Speed of Mana Draught is increased by 30% while in water.
1599.lore: A refreshing drink best shared with friends.

1600.name: Ripper's Lash
1600.desc:
Active: Flay
Embeds thorns into all enemies in a 200 unit radius. Affected units take additional damage when attacked for 10 seconds.
1600.lore: The Fae horticulturists of Revtel are known to push the boundaries of both cross pollination and safety.

1601.name: Crippling Crossbow
1601.desc:
Active: Hobble
Hits an enemy for 25 damage, then slows them by 65% and reduces Health Restoration by 40% for 4 seconds. The slow gradually fades over the duration of the spell.
1601.lore: The ever-weeping woodgrain of this crossbow coats every bolt in a potent but short-lived narcotic sap.

1602.name: Gale Guard
1602.desc:
Active: Cyclonic Shield
Envelops the caster in an all damage barrier that absorbs 75% of incoming damage up to a max of 225. Lasts for up to 10 seconds and while the barrier is active you have 50% Slow Resistance.
1602.lore: If one truly listens, they can always rely upon the wind to make its will known.

1603.name: Gunpowder Gauntlet
1603.desc:
Passive: Beat the Crowd
Your next attack deals an additional 40 magic damage and splashes to units within 250 units for 60% of the original attack's damage plus the additional magic damage.
1603.lore: A 'harmless' prank that went entirely too far.

1604.name: Searing Signet
1604.desc:
Passive: Burn Through
Instances of magic damage from spells over 60 ignites enemies, causing them to take 75 magic damage over 6 seconds. Burn damage against non-hero targets is decreased by 50%.
notes: Will not ignite enemies that are more than 2000 range away.
1604.lore: To torture a magic user, one must devise means far beyond the mundane.

1605.name: Serrated Shiv
1605.desc:
Passive: Gut 'Em
Attacks have a 30% chance to have True Strike and deal 10% of the target's current health as bonus physical damage. Deals a flat bonus of 200 against Roshan.
1605.lore: Too dangerous for taskwork, this blade's only purpose is vile murder.

1606.name: Pollywog Charm
1606.desc:
Active: Ribbit
Increases the health regeneration of a target ally by 8 for 14 seconds. While standing in water, the blessed unit also moves 10% faster.
1606.lore: A tiny trinket that wriggles when wet.

1607.name: Magnifying Monocle
1607.desc:
Passive: Keen Eye
Increases cast range by 100 and attack range by 100 (Melee & Ranged). Taking over 25 damage from a player controlled source or Roshan disables this effect for 6 seconds.

1608.name: Pyrrhic Cloak
1608.desc:
Active: Retribution
For the next 6 seconds, 75% of damage taken by the caster is reflected to the target unit as physical damage if they are within 1200 units away.
notes: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
1608.lore: There are generals that care far less about the survival of their troops than the destruction of their enemies.

1609.name: Madstone Bundle
1609.desc: Collect to craft new Neutral Items.

1637.name: Kobold Cup
1637.desc:
Active: One for the Road
Increases movement speed of all allied units by 10% in a 1000 unit radius around the caster for 8 seconds.
1637.lore: The Kobold King will sip when he damn well pleases.

1638.name: Dormant Curio
1638.desc:
Passive: Hidden Potential
Neutral Artifacts you craft while holding a Dormant Curio have their potency increased by 30%.
notes: Certain stats on the next artifact will be amplified. Will not amplify cooldown, mana cost, or cast range.
1638.lore: Everyone has an idea, but no one has a clue.

1639.name: Sister's Shroud
1639.desc:
Passive: Veiled
When falling below 50% HP, gain 150% evasion for 5 seconds. While active, dodging an attack decreases the evasion bonus by 75% of its current value.
Passive: Last Caress
Veiled cooldown is only reset if the wearer dies or kills an enemy hero.
notes: Does not trigger from damage by non-player controlled creeps
1639.lore: A pall that draped the sarcophagus of the First Sister.

1640.name: Jidi Pollen Bag
1640.desc:
Active: Pollinate
Spreads pollen on all enemy units in a 900 unit radius for 9 seconds, decreasing their health restoration by 65% and dealing damage per second, the total equal to 9% of their maximum health.
notes: Damage is non-lethal and classified as HP Loss.
1640.lore: Very dangerous. Very difficult to obtain more.

1641.name: Outworld Staff
1641.desc:
Active: Self-Exile
Makes the caster completely invulnerable and disabled for 0.7 seconds. When returning to the world, the caster takes 5% of their maximum health as damage.
notes: Damage taken when returning is non-lethal and disables Blink Dagger and other items that are muted upon taking damage.
1641.lore: Proof that the lone sentinel was not always so.

1642.name: Dezun Bloodrite
1642.desc:
Passive: Blood Invocation
Spells have a 20% larger Area of Effect, but now additionally cost health equal to 25% of their mana cost.
1642.lore: The gateway to a lost lineage of power, unlocked only with blood.

1643.name: Giant's Maul
1643.desc:
Passive: Crushing Blow
Empowers the next attack to be a critical hit dealing 150% damage. Hitting an enemy with an empowered attack temporarily decreases their movement speed by 10%, attack speed by 15%, and cast speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

1644.name: Divine Regalia
1644.desc:
Passive: Exalted
Increases outgoing damage by 25%. Dying permanently disables this Neutral Item and the current Enchantment is lost.
1644.lore: So magnificent, it cannot abide failure.

1645.name: Disgraced Regalia
1645.desc:
Passive: Fallen
You have died and thus get nothing.

1076.name: Specialist's Array
1076.desc:
Passive: Splitshot
Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 2 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.
1076.lore: An impressive kit of trigger enhancements born in an aging assassin's idle mind.

1858.name: Hydra's Breath
1858.desc:
Passive: Miasma
Attacks poison enemies, dealing 2.5% of the target's Max HP as Magical Damage per second for 3 seconds.

Passive: Polycephaly
Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 3 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects except for Miasma. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.
notes: Attack Range bonuses from Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.
Does not trigger on attacks from illusions.

1716.name: Weighted Dice
1716.desc:
Passive: Loaded
Increases your base damage maximum by 8. When calculating your base damage or creep bounty from last hits, the value is computed 2 times and the highest value is taken.

1717.name: Ash Legion Shield
1717.desc:
Active: Shield Wall
Reduce your own movement speed by 20 to provide a 180 physical damage barrier to allied player controlled targets in a 800 unit radius. Lasts for 6 seconds.

1718.name: Riftshadow Prism
1718.desc:
Active: Refract
Spend 4% of your current life total to create a full health strong illusion that lasts for 20 seconds. The illusion has 60% outgoing damage, takes 200% of incoming damage, and has 100% Item Potency.

1719.name: Metamorphic Mandible
1719.desc:
Active: Pupate
Enter into an insect form for 5 seconds, increasing magic resistance by 40% and movement speed by 15%. While an insect, your size is decreased and your armor is reduced by 30%.

1720.name: Idol of Scree'auk
1720.desc:
Active: False Flight
Gain 60% slow resistance, phased movement, and 40% evasion for 6.5 seconds.

1721.name: Flayer's Bota
1721.desc:
Active: Bloodthirst
Gain 15% base damage and 30 attack speed for 9 seconds.

Passive: Bloodrush
Enemy heroes dying within 1500 units reset the cooldown of Bloodthirst.

1859.name: Spellslinger
1859.desc:
Passive: Salvo
20% of the mana used to cast abilities is recovered over 8 seconds.

1860.name: Prophet's Pendulum
1860.desc:
Passive: Linger
30% of incoming damage is delayed over 8 seconds.

1861.name: Stonefeather Satchel
1861.desc:
Toggle: Transmogrify
Toggle to switch the contents of the Satchel between a pound of Feathers or Rocks.

Feathers: increase movement speed by 15 and distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.

Rocks: increase armor by 5 and decrease the distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.

1862.name: Enchanter's Bauble
1862.desc:
Passive: Enchant
Increases the bonuses of the item's Neutral Enchantment by 10%. Every time this item is crafted again the bonus is increased by 35%.

1863.name: Harmonizer
1863.desc:
Passive: Balance
Gain 7% spell mana cost reduction for every ability off cooldown and 9% Spell Lifesteal for every ability on cooldown.
notes: Only considers abilities that are visible and have a cooldown.

1911.name: Helm of the Hivemind
1911.desc:
Passive: Brood Awakening
Merge consciousness with an unknown monarch, gaining 120 cast range. Bonus cast range is increased by 80 and maximum health is decreased by 8% for every assimilated hero on both teams.

1884.name: Claszian Timepiece
1884.desc:
Passive: Compress Time
Increases Casting Speed by 25%. Whenever you cast a spell with a non-zero cast time, your Cooldown Speed is reduced by 10% for 8 seconds. This debuff stacks.

1916.name: Brick
1916.desc:
Active: Brick
Tosses a brick at the target enemy, removing 200 from any active barrier and dealing 150 physical damage.
notes: Barrier damage ignores any reductions and affects any kind of barrier in the following order: Magical Barrier, Physical Barrier, All-Damage Barrier.
If barrier damage destroys one type of barrier, the remaining barrier damage is dealt to the next barrier. Any remaining barrier damage is not dealt to the player.

1917.name: Balmhook
1917.desc:
Passive: Shepherd's Protection
Targeting a friendly unit with a spell increases their Health Regeneration by 12 for 12 seconds.

1864.name: Conjurer's Catalyst
1864.desc:
Passive: Spellover
Dealing 150 spell damage to an enemy causes them to overheat and deal damage to their allies in a 300 unit radius. Hero targets deal 80 damage to their allies, other targets deal 20 damage.
notes: Spellover has a 0.1s cooldown between overheats.
Accumulated damage resets if no damage is dealt to the target for 6s.

1868.name: Forager's Kit
1868.desc:
Passive: Forage
When the cooldown is ready, nearby trees that can be foraged will appear. By standing next to a tree for 0.75s, you can forage the tree and find flora, fungi or a bag of gold containing 30 gold.

1869.name: Vital Toadstool
1869.desc:
Use: Munch
Grants 1% max health regeneration to the target for 10 seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
notes: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

1870.name: Ironwood Nut
1870.desc:
Use: Munch
Grants 1 permanent primary attribute.
notes: Universal heroes get 0.4 bonus to all attributes.

1871.name: Tomo'kan Ringcap
1871.desc:
Use: Munch
Instantly restores 50 mana + 5% of the target's max mana when consumed
notes: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

1872.name: Chasm Stone
notes: AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.

1873.name: Partisan's Brand
1873.desc:
Passive: Brand
Increases spell damage dealt to player controlled targets by 7%.
notes: Player controlled targets includes heroes and any creep summoned or converted by them.

1880.name: Red Ledger
1880.desc:
Active: Most Wanted
Generates a list of hero bounties. Killing a hero on the list grants 50 gold plus an additional 12 for every level higher the target is than you. Assists award 75% of the bounty.
notes: Automatically generates a new list once all bounties have been collected.
Can be manually activated if off cooldown to replace the current bounty list.

1881.name: Berserker's Hood
1881.desc:
Active: Rage
Restricts vision to a 30-degree cone in front for 7s. While enraged, you gain 30% Status Resistance and 25 Attack Speed.

1882.name: Vile Phial
1882.desc:
Passive: Toxic Tincture
Attacking the same enemy 4 times within 10 seconds poisons them for 5 seconds, reducing their Health Restoration by 35% and dealing 40 damage per second.

1883.name: Nothl Sigil
1883.desc:
Passive: Blood from Stone
Reduces the mana cost of your spells by 30%, and increases their health cost by 150% of the mana saved.

1953.name: Sabatons of Mordiggian
1953.desc:
Toggle: Mordiggian's Oath
While active, grants +40 damage, +30 Strength, and +5 armor, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly with 20% increased movement speed on melee heroes and 10% on ranged heroes. Also grants up to 40% slow resistance, scaling down with your current health percentage. Drains 45 health per second.

You cannot die from the health drain, nor from the strength loss when deactivated. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
